messages.subject: 2025 Immcantation Users Group Meeting
messages.body_plain:
Registration and abstract submission for the 2025 Immcantation Users Group Meeting <https://immcantation.github.io/users-meeting/2025/index.html> are now open. Please join us for this free virtual meeting on January 30th, 2025 from 10:00 am to 1:30 pm (ET) to learn how researchers are applying the Immcantation <https://immcantation.org> framework for high-throughput bulk and single-cell B cell receptor repertoire analysis. All topics showing the applicability of Immcantation are welcome — as always! This year, we are especially encouraging the submission of abstracts showing how the community is using Immcantation to reconstruct and analyze B-cell lineage trees, to identify novel alleles, and to perform analysis with the Nextflow pipeline nf-core/airrflow <https://nf-co.re/airrflow>. The deadline to submit an abstract is November 1st, 2024.

To learn more about the event, visit: https://immcantation.github.io/users-meeting/2025/index.html.
